reviews.title: KYC verification pending for 5 days!
reviews.text: I submitted my bank statement and Aadhar 5 days ago. Still showing under verification. Missed buying the dip! Fix this issue. My email is [REDACTED_EMAIL] and phone [REDACTED_PHONE].

reviews.title: Demat account creation failing constantly
reviews.text: App gets stuck on signature upload step. Keeps throwing error code 502 server issue. Client ID [REDACTED_ACCOUNT_ID]. Please resolve this account creation bug ASAP.

reviews.title: Re-KYC process is extremely slow and painful
reviews.text: I updated my address via Digilocker but Groww app is not syncing the updated details. Support team is not responding. Contact me on [REDACTED_PHONE].

reviews.title: Bank account verification rejected twice without reason
reviews.text: Uploaded penny drop verification and cancelled cheque twice. Both times rejected saying name mismatch when bank account has exact same name.

reviews.title: Nominee addition process failing on OTP step
reviews.text: Trying to add my nominee details for Demat account but NSDL e-sign portal keeps timing out. Groww customer support is unavailable.

reviews.title: Kra KYC status showing on hold for 2 weeks
reviews.text: KRA verification status is stuck on validation on hold. Cannot place new equity stock buy orders. Kindly check folio account [REDACTED_ACCOUNT_ID].

reviews.title: GST invoice for F&O brokerage not available for download
reviews.text: Trying to download quarterly tax report and PnL statement for filing ITR-3. System throws 404 server error.

reviews.title: Bank penny drop failed for Kotak account
reviews.text: Re-verified link bank account using Rs 1 penny drop. Amount deducted from bank but Groww status says penny drop failed.

reviews.title: NRI Demat account onboarding is super complicated
reviews.text: Submitted NRE/NRO passport copy and PIS permission letter 3 weeks back. No update from compliance team.

reviews.title: Options chart lagging during morning market hours!
reviews.text: Nifty 50 option charts freeze between 9:15 AM and 9:45 AM. Lost 12,000 rupees due to order execution latency! Groww team please fix trading view charts.

reviews.title: SL order triggered late during market volatility
reviews.text: Stop loss market order took 4 seconds to place. Slippage is huge in Bank Nifty options trading. Needs ultra low latency servers for active scalpers.

reviews.title: TradingView charts not loading properly in dark mode
reviews.text: Candlesticks disappear when switching timeframes from 1m to 5m in F&O mode. Please fix this rendering bug on Android devices.

reviews.title: GTT order failed to execute when price hit trigger
reviews.text: Set GTT buy order for Tata Motors at 920. Stock touched 918 but order stayed in pending state. Lost buying opportunity.

reviews.title: Option Chain strike prices not updating live
reviews.text: In Bank Nifty weekly expiry, Option Chain premiums lag by 10-15 seconds compared to NSE live feed. Unacceptable for day traders.

reviews.title: Pledge margin collateral not updating for F&O selling
reviews.text: Pledged my Liquid ETF holdings yesterday. Collateral margin is still showing zero for option writing. Ticket ID [REDACTED_ACCOUNT_ID].

reviews.title: Square off order rejected due to RMS margin rule
reviews.text: Tried squaring off intraday position at 3:15 PM but system threw RMS margin breach error. Forced auto-square off by admin with penalty fee.

reviews.title: Cover Order option missing for equity intraday
reviews.text: Earlier Groww supported Cover Orders with built-in stop loss. After latest update, CO order type is completely removed.

reviews.title: Stock alert notification triggered 10 minutes late
reviews.text: Set price alert for Reliance Industries at 2900. Push notification arrived after stock already bounced back to 2925.

reviews.title: Money debited from bank but not showing in Groww balance
reviews.text: Transferred Rs 25,000 via UPI on Monday. Amount debited from HDFC but Groww shows balance zero. Order ID [REDACTED_ACCOUNT_ID]. Kindly refund my money!

reviews.title: Withdrawal taking more than 24 hours to credit
reviews.text: Groww promises 1-day withdrawal to linked bank account but my payout is still pending after 36 hours. Regards, [REDACTED_NAME].

reviews.title: UPI auto-pay for SIP failed twice this month
reviews.text: Google Pay Mandate failed for my Parag Parikh Flexi Cap SIP investment. Groww charged auto-pay failure fee which is unfair.

reviews.title: IMPS fund transfer failed but wallet not updated
reviews.text: Transferred funds using IMPS netbanking. Money debited from ICICI account but not credited to Groww trading balance after 8 hours.

reviews.title: PhonePe mandate set up failing for monthly SIP
reviews.text: Trying to set up auto-debit for Nippon India Small Cap Fund SIP. PhonePe UPI mandate approval page keeps crashing.

reviews.title: Dividend payout not credited to primary bank account
reviews.text: TCS dividend payout was declared last week. Money was not credited to SBI bank account linked with Groww Demat account.

reviews.title: Fingerprint login fails continuously after update
reviews.text: After latest app update v24.1, biometric sensor login says credential mismatch. Forced to enter 4-digit PIN every single time I open app.

reviews.title: App crashes when opening SME IPO section
reviews.text: Whenever I click on upcoming SME IPOs tab, app abruptly closes. Using Samsung Galaxy S22 on Android 14. Please fix crash bug.

reviews.title: Network timeout error during peak market hours
reviews.text: App displays 'Something went wrong, check connection' between 9:15 AM and 9:30 AM every trading day. Mobile data works fine on all other apps.

reviews.title: Watchlist stocks resetting automatically
reviews.text: Created a custom watchlist of 15 IT stocks. After app restart, the watchlist cleared automatically. Very annoying bug.

reviews.title: Groww Assistant chatbot is completely useless
reviews.text: Automated chatbot keeps giving pre-written articles. No option to escalate or connect with a human support agent. Email help@groww.in goes unanswered.

reviews.title: Support ticket closed without resolving my issue
reviews.text: Raised a ticket for discrepancy in PnL report for F&O trades. Support team marked ticket as resolved without providing explanation.

reviews.title: Good app but needs Option Chain Basket Order feature
reviews.text: Interface is very clean for beginners. But please add basket order execution for hedging option strategies and multi-chart view on desktop web app.

reviews.title: Smooth SIP investing, add Tax Loss Harvesting tool
reviews.text: Investing in mutual funds is super easy. Would rate 5 stars if Groww introduces automated tax loss harvesting feature for long term equity stocks.

reviews.title: Dark mode color contrast needs improvement for PnL
reviews.text: Green and red PnL colors are hard to distinguish in dark mode environment. Please add colorblind accessibility options in settings.

reviews.title: Add Trailing Stop Loss for Equity intraday trading
reviews.text: App is fast and responsive. Adding trailing stop loss feature for equity intraday trades would make it the ultimate trading platform.

reviews.title: Please add Multi-chart layout for desktop web app
reviews.text: Using Groww web interface on laptop. We need 4-chart layout option like TradingView to monitor multiple Nifty option strike prices simultaneously.

reviews.title: Step-up SIP calculator is very useful
reviews.text: Love the step-up SIP option for mutual funds. Would be great if Groww also adds automatic portfolio rebalancing alerts.

reviews.title: Add Market Depth (5 depth bids & offers) for stocks
reviews.text: Intraday stock traders need level 2 market depth data. Currently only top bid and ask prices are visible.

reviews.title: Best investment app in India for beginners!
reviews.text: Zero brokerage on direct mutual funds and instant US stocks tracking. Super intuitive dashboard for long term wealth creation. Kudos to Groww team!

reviews.title: Seamless IPO application and instant UPI mandate
reviews.text: Applied for Bajaj Housing Finance IPO in less than 30 seconds via UPI mandate. Got allotment status notification instantly. Love the smooth UI!

reviews.title: Super fast stocks & ETF buying experience
reviews.text: Switched from Zerodha to Groww for simplicity. Minimalist design, fast search, zero clutter. Highly recommended for beginner investors in India.

reviews.title: Great mutual fund analytics & step-up SIP option
reviews.text: Step-up SIP feature helped me increase investments annually automatically. Overlap portfolio checker tool is very insightful for diversification.

reviews.title: Instant instant redemption for Liquid funds
reviews.text: Instant withdrawal feature for ICICI Prudential Liquid Fund worked like magic. Money reached bank account in less than 2 minutes.

reviews.title: Cleanest UI among all Indian stock brokers
reviews.text: No clutter, no annoying popups, clean charts, and fast search. Groww is hands down the best platform for direct mutual fund investing.

reviews.title: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) buying was super smooth
reviews.text: Subscribed to RBI Sovereign Gold Bonds batch via Groww app. Got Rs 50 per gram discount and certificate of holding delivered directly to email.

reviews.title: Mutual fund portfolio import tool is awesome
reviews.text: Imported my external CAS statement from CAMS in one click. All my old mutual fund holdings across brokers are now tracked in one single dashboard.
